description: Using JWST and a natural gravitational lens, astronomers measured a six-billion-solar-mass dormant black hole more than 10 billion light-years away. The discovery offers a rare glimpse into how galaxies and black holes evolved when the universe was just three billion years old.
title: James Webb Space Telescope Weighs Most Distant Dormant Black Hole Ever Detected

description: Apple is reportedly introducing independent volume controls in iOS 27, allowing iPhone users to adjust ringtone, alarm, timer, and system sound levels separately. The feature appears in the Sounds and Haptics settings and includes a new Match Ringtone Volume option. Users who disable the setting gain access to dedicated controls for alarms, timers, alerts, and system sounds. The update addresses a long-standing limitation in iOS and brings the iPhone closer to Android's approach to audio management and customisation.
title: iOS 27 Finally Adds Separate Volume Controls for Ringtones and Alarms, Just Like Android Phones

description: Apple revealed the list of compatible devices that will receive the latest iOS 27, macOS Golden Gate (macOS 27), and iPadOS 27 updates, during the keynote of the Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2026 on Monday. All the iPhone models that were eligible to receive the iOS 26 update are part of the list of devices compatible with running the latest iOS 27 version. This means that the iPhone 11 series, which was launched about six and a half years ago, in September 2019, can run the new iOS 27 update, with the updated Liquid Glass design.
title: WWDC 2026: iOS 27, iPadOS 27 and macOS Golden Gate Won't Be Compatible With These Devices

description: Stellar Blade: Blood Rain features a new protagonist, Evie, who is younger and shorter than Eve, the main character from the first game. Developer Shift Up has now addressed the design of the new character and said that Evie will have more of a personality.
title: Stellar Blade: Blood Rain Protagonist Will Have More of a Personality, Says Shift Up

description: Samsung is said to be developing Galaxy Tab Active 6. This rugged tablet will arrive as a successor to the Galaxy Tab Active 5 introduced in early 2024. The new model is expected to launch in 2027 and could bring upgrades over its predecessor. For global markets, the tablet is said to carry the model number SM-X316B. The Galaxy Tab Active 5 has MIL-military-grade (MIL-STD-810H) durability and an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab Active 6 Reportedly Set to Launch in 2027 With 5G Connectivity

description: AirDrop compatibility has reportedly started appearing on the OnePlus 15 through Google's Quick Share platform. According to a recent report, the feature enables direct file transfers between the smartphone and Apple devices, including iPhones, iPads, and Macs. The OnePlus 15 is currently the only OnePlus device expected to receive the functionality. Users may only need to update Quick Share through the Google Play Store to access the feature. Support for similar cross-platform transfers has also expanded to other premium Android smartphones.
title: OnePlus 15 Gains AirDrop Support via Quick Share as Google Expands Availability Beyond Pixel, Samsung Phones
How AI Is Empowering the Future of TVs In Your Living Room

description: Redmi Note 17 series could be launched in select global markets soon as one of the handset in the lineup has been spotted on the European Economic Community (EEC) certification database with the model number 26081RA18G. Separately, an unnamed Vivo smartphone, with the model number V2619, has also been listed on the certification website. While the listings do not reveal any specifications or features of the upcoming Redmi Note 17 series and Vivo handsets, they do suggest that these smartphones could be launched in select global markets soon. According to the report, the Redmi Note 17 series could be launched as early as August.
title: Redmi Note 17 Visits EEC Certification Database Along With a New Vivo Handset, Hinting at Imminent Global Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) database hints at its upcoming launch in India. Additionally, the key specifications of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and Galaxy Z Fold 8 have leaked online. They are tipped to feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipsets and two 10-megapixel selfie shooters. They could support 45W wired and 25W wireless charging.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Reportedly Listed on BIS Database, Tipster Leaks Key Specifications

description: The UK Financial Conduct Authority has proposed allowing authorised investment funds to allocate up to 10 percent of their holdings to crypto exchange-traded notes. The proposal aims to expand access while maintaining consumer protection measures.
title: UK Regulator Proposes Allowing Retail Funds to Hold Up to 10 Percent in Crypto ETNs

description: Apple's Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2026 kicked off yesterday with a keynote address by CEO Tim Cook. It proved to be one of the company's most significant software-focused events in recent years. Apple unveiled a completely redesigned Siri experience and detailed updates coming to iOS 27 and similar updates for the iPad, Vision Pro, Apple Watch, and Mac. Here's a look at the biggest announcements Apple made during its WWDC 2026 keynote.
title: WWDC 2026: From iOS 27 to Siri AI, Here Are Apple's Top Announcements From the Event

description: Nintendo has announced a Nintendo Direct broadcast, featuring upcoming games for the Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 platforms. The show will be followed by a Nintendo Treehouse: Live show, featuring gameplay from select titles shown during the event. Nintendo Direct will be roughly 50 minutes long.
title: Nintendo Has Announced a 50-Minute Nintendo Direct Broadcast for June 9

description: Lava Bold N2 5G is now available for purchase in India through Amazon. The smartphone is priced at Rs. 12,499, while a launch offer brings the effective price down to Rs. 11,999. It features a 6.75-inch HD+ display with a 120Hz refresh rate, a 6nm Unisoc T8200 processor, 4GB RAM, and 64GB storage. The handset also packs a 6,000mAh battery with 18W charging support, runs Android 16, and includes IP64-rated dust and water resistance.
title: Lava Bold N2 5G Goes on Sale in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 6.75-Inch Display: Price, Offers

description: Created by George Kay, Lupin Part 4 is set to mark its digital debut only on Netflix this October. The series will continue right from the instances in Part 3.
title: Lupin Part 4 OTT Release Date Revealed: Know When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Written by John Logan, Michael is a 2026 biographical film that is based on the life of Michael Jackson. Now Available for rent.
title: Michael Now Available for Rent Online: Know Where to Stream Michael Jackson Biopic Online?

description: The Oppo Reno 16 series was launched in China last month, and its India debut is expected to take place soon. While the company has yet to tease its arrival in the country, the Indian and global variant of the vanilla Oppo Reno 16 has been sighted on a benchmarking platform. The listing not only reveals the handset's moniker but also sheds light on some of its key specifications. It is seen with 12GB of RAM and Adreno 722 GPU, running Android 16.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Indian Variant Listed on Geekbench With Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 Chip, Android 16

description: Meta claims that WhatsApp users were targets of a fresh wave of "spear phishing" attacks, which were carried out by an NSO Group-linked entity. The US-based tech giant says that it has managed to thwart the “social engineering attempts”. The tech giant said that the NSO Group-linked attackers tried to dupe WhatsApp users by tricking them into clicking on malicious links, which would redirect them to an external website. Meta claims that this appears to be similar to the “previously reported 1-click phishing campaigns” that have been orchestrated by the Israeli spyware firm.
title: WhatsApp Claims NSO Group-Linked Entity Unsuccessfully Carried Out Fresh Phishing Attacks Against Users

description: iCloud Shared Albums will introduce cross-platform photo sharing with full-resolution support. With this update announced during the WWDC 2026, Android and Windows users will be able to share photos to iCloud Shared Albums while retaining full-resolution image quality. This functionality will be available with the release of iOS 27 and macOS 27 this fall. Right now, Android users cannot view or participate in iCloud Shared Albums.
title: Apple Will Soon Allow Android, Windows Users to Share Photos to iCloud Shared Albums

description: Samsung is rolling out a new firmware update for its Galaxy smartwatch lineup, which includes the May 2026 Wear OS security patch. The latest release is currently available for eligible models, including the Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 series. As per the South Korean tech conglomerate, the latest update brings security improvements by addressing dozens of vulnerabilities affecting Android and One UI. It is also said to enhance overall system reliability, stability, and day-to-day performance on supported models.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 8, Watch 7 Get May 2026 Wear OS Update With Security Fixes

description: Apple has announced a dedicated custom EQ feature for AirPods as part of iOS 27. Revealed at WWDC 2026, the update will allow users to adjust audio settings through a new equaliser interface instead of relying on existing accessibility tools or Apple Music presets. Preview images suggest support for broad frequency adjustments alongside a real-time visual graph. Apple has not yet disclosed whether users can save multiple profiles or use the feature with third-party Bluetooth audio devices. The update arrives later this year.
title: WWDC 2026: Apple Announces Custom EQ Feature for AirPods With iOS 27 Update

description: Bitcoin remained above $63,000 after large institutional purchases helped steady sentiment following last week’s sharp correction. However, continued ETF outflows and uncertainty ahead of US inflation data and the Federal Reserve meeting are keeping investors cautious about the market’s near-term direction.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $63,400 as Institutional Buying Counters ETF Outflow Pressure

description: Redmi Turbo 5 will come with a 7,540mAh battery in India. While this is slightly smaller than the 7,560mAh battery found in the Chinese variant, Xiaomi will retain the same fast-charging capabilities. The Indian model is confirmed to support 100W wired charging, matching its Chinese counterpart.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 India Variant to Feature Slightly Smaller Battery Than Chinese Version

description: Apple began rolling out the first developer beta of the iOS 27 update after the keynote presentation for the Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2026 concluded. A software researcher has reportedly spotted strings of code hinting at a device that can be folded and unfolded inside the iOS 27 beta. This is said to be an indication of Apple's first foldable phone, which is expected to be marketed as the iPhone Ultra. Apart from this, the tech giant also showcased various new features coming with the iOS 27 and macOS 27 updates, which reportedly signal towards an iPad-like wide-screen iPhone.
title: Apple's First iOS 27 Beta Reportedly Contains Various Clues About Its Purported Foldable iPhone

description: Honor is rumoured to expand its X80 smartphone lineup in China with the launch of several new models, with a recent leak hinting at the launch of the standard X80 this month. According to a tipster, the purported handset could be joined by another model, ubiquitously known as the Honor X80 Pro Max. It is said to feature an 11,000mAh battery, along with support for 90W wired fast charging.
title: Honor X80 Pro Max in Development With Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 SoC and 11,000mAh Battery, Tipster Claims

description: Instagram has started rolling out a new Reorder Grid feature that allows users to rearrange posts on their profile without affecting original upload dates. The tool lets users move content to different positions on their grid, offering greater flexibility in profile presentation. The update is aimed at creators, businesses, and everyday users who want more control over how their profiles appear. Instagram says the feature can be accessed by long-pressing a post and selecting the Reorder Grid option from the menu.
title: Instagram Lets Users Reorder Their Profile Grid With New Customisation Feature

description: Sam Bankman-Fried has formally applied for a presidential pardon from US President Donald Trump. The request comes as the former FTX CEO continues to challenge his fraud conviction and prison sentence linked to the collapse of the crypto exchange.
title: Sam Bankman-Fried Seeks Presidential Pardon From US President Donald Trump

description: Samsung is reportedly working on the Galaxy A18, which is expected to arrive as the successor to the Galaxy A17. The upcoming handset has now been spotted on Samsung's internal servers. The Galaxy A18 is likely to arrive as a budget offering. It was spotted on European test servers with the model number SM-A185F. This could be the LTE-only variant of the smartphone.
title: Samsung Galaxy A18 Reportedly Listed on Samsung's Test Servers With One UI 9 Ahead of Anticipated Debut

description: Microsoft announced that Gears of War: E-Day and Clockwork Revolution would be Xbox console exclusives, but fans can expect more first-party Xbox titles to remain on the Xbox platform. The company's chief strategy officer has said that the exclusive announcements were not a "one-off" and Xbox users can expect a "reliable pipeline" of Xbox exclusives in the future.
title: Gears of War: E-Day, Clockwork Revolution Not 'One-Off', More Xbox Exclusives on Their Way

description: Apple has announced several refinements to its Liquid Glass design language in iOS 27 and across its software platforms. The update introduces a new Settings slider that lets users adjust the level of transparency, alongside changes aimed at improving visual clarity and contrast. Apple has also redesigned app icons to appear sharper and more distinct. On macOS 27 Golden Gate, the company is bringing back familiar interface elements such as coloured sidebar icons, edge-to-edge sidebars, and a more consistent toolbar design.
title: WWDC 2026: Apple's iOS 27 Update Includes Slider to Control Liquid Glass Opacity Following User Feedback

description: Apple announced WWDC 2026 on Monday as the latest operating system for iPhone. During the keynote address, the Cupertino-based tech giant showcased a range of performance enhancements coming to the iPhone with iOS 27. While the new Apple Intelligence and Siri features grabbed the headlines, significant under-the-hood optimisations were also announced. iOS 27 will bring extensive bug fixes, stability improvements, and system refinements, resulting in noticeable speed gains across apps and services.
title: Apple's iOS 27 Update to Arrive With Major Performance Upgrades for iPhone Including Faster AirDrop, App Launches and Search

description: Apple, at its annual Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC 2026), announced iOS 27 alongside iPadOS 27 and macOS 27. The update includes a revamped Siri app and upgrades to Visual Intelligence. One key highlight is the new Siri mode in the Camera app that can analyse objects and take actions directly based on them in real time. Visual Intelligence expanded to the Apple Vision Pro.
title: WWDC 2026: Apple Brings Visual Intelligence to Siri, Lets Users Access AI Information via iPhone Camera

description: Apple introduced new tools for developers during the keynote presentation of the WWDC 2026, including new ways for them to market their apps and games, discovery and engagement tools, and new ways to offer subscriptions with StoreKit 2, and an updated App Review process. Now, app publishers can present their apps and games on the App Store with creative assets, rich images, and videos, appearing on the product page headers and search results, apart from the “standard” screenshots and page previews.
title: WWDC 2026: Apple Showcases New Developer Tools for Improved App Store Discovery and Marketing

description: Canva experienced a server outage globally on Tuesday, which made parts of its website inaccessible to users. The company has since fixed the issue. Gadgets 360 staff members were able to verify that the platform is now accessible. During the server, the tech firm updated its status page to acknowledge the issue. At 1:41 pm AEST (9:11 am IST), the tech firm said, “Some users may have issues accessing Canva. Our team is urgently looking into this and we will provide an update soon.” According to the global downtime tracker, Downdetector, the first instance of the outage was reported at 8:42 am, reaching 207 reports by 8:57 am, and finally reaching a peak with 661 user reports at 9:12 am.
title: Canva Restores Services After a Server Outage Affected Hundreds of Users Globally

description: Apple has announced the expansion of its child safety tools at WWDC 2026. The company has announced new features to give parents greater control over their children's digital experiences across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Coming with iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27, the updates include curated recommendations for essential apps, Ask to Browse, Time Allowances, and a redesigned Screen Time experience.
title: WWDC 2026: Apple Expands Parental Controls With Ask to Browse, Time Allowances and New Screen Time Features

description: Apple rolled out the iOS 27 Developer Beta 1 update to registered developers on Monday, shortly after hosting the Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2026 keynote. The latest iteration of the iPhone operating system brings several improvements, including enhancements to the Liquid Glass design language, new features in Photos and Mail apps, and improved child safety features. While iOS 27 is scheduled to be publicly released later this year, those who want to try out all of the new features can download the iOS 27 Developer Beta 1 update.
title: iOS 27 Release Date and How to Update: Full List of Supported Devices From iPhone 11 to iPhone 17 Pro Max

description: Apple revealed its revamped AI architecture on Monday, during the keynote presentation for Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2026. Demonstrated with the help of concentric circles, Apple shows that its foundational models are situated at the core of its AI architecture, bringing new AI tools and features to iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro models. Apple’s foundational AI models support multimodality. This means that they are capable of generating responses based on text, voice, and image-based prompts.
title: WWDC 2026: Apple Unveils Its New Gemini-Powered AI Architecture That Will Enable Siri AI

description: Apple on Monday unveiled iOS 27 and other corresponding operating systems for the iPhone, iPad, and Mac. While the latest updates bring several quality-of-life upgrades, the most notable introduction is Siri AI, Apple’s smarter version of Siri that was promised nearly two years ago. The Cupertino-based tech giant’s major overhaul of the voice assistant will be released with iOS 27 later this year. However, Apple said that users in the European Union (EU) will not receive the new Siri AI experience upon the release of iOS 27 and iPadOS 27.
title: Apple Delays Siri AI Launch in EU on iOS 27, iPadOS 27 Due to DMA Rules; Cites Privacy and Security Risks
